reviews.author: Naj Mez
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, my experience at this salon was very disappointing. Some of the staff were extremely unprofessional and lacked basic customer service skills. As paying clients, we expect to be treated with respect—not to be spoken to rudely or screamed at. We are paying for a service, not asking for it for free.

The blow-dry was also poorly done and felt rushed. Clients should receive the service they are paying for, not feel like corners are being cut or that they’re being taken advantage of.

On a positive note, I would like to thank Evon for the excellent manicure and pedicure. She was professional, attentive, and did a wonderful job. She was the only highlight of an otherwise disappointing visit.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously and works on improving both staff professionalism and the quality of service
reviews.owner_reply:
Hello Ms Najla .
Am very sorry for the bad experience in our Salon.
I did investigated that issue.
And the staff was suspended immediately for her behaviour.

reviews.author: Belinda Dedase
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Pinky’s Saloon yesterday 29 Sep Tuesday.

I felt welcomed and comfortable.

The entire team is amazing — highly competent, respectful, friendly, and genuinely attentive to their clients.

What I especially appreciate is how well they work together as a team. Their relationship as colleagues feels healthy and respectful, and you can really feel the positive atmosphere. They communicate naturally, know when to converse and when to give you your own relaxing time, and everyone is approachable and warm. It honestly feels like being at home with people who care about what they do.

A special appreciation to the following members of the team:

🌸 Jamila – An all-around Filipina beauty professional who does everything with care and skill — from manicure and pedicure to massage. She is attentive, professional, and makes you feel comfortable throughout the service.

🌸 Aya – She is an expert when it comes to the moroccan bath. Her technique and attention to detail made the experience very relaxing and enjoyable.

🌸 Asmita / Kay – Both are wonderful when it comes to manicure and pedicure, including gelish. They are extremely patient, careful, and meticulous with their work. You can tell that they genuinely want their clients to be happy with the results.

🌸Tito – A talented hairdresser who clearly knows his craft, truly masters his work and takes pride in what he does. His expertise and attention to detail are impressive.

Overall, I really admire the teamwork, professionalism, and positive energy among the staff. Everyone smiles, treats clients with respect, and makes you feel comfortable from start to finish.

The location is also very convenient and easy to find, which is another plus.

Thank you, Pinky’s Saloon, for the wonderful service and for having such an amazing team. Keep up the great work!

I’ll definitely be happy to come back. ❤️
